The defendants nos.I-8, 10-11 and defendant No. 9, contested the suit by written statement denying material allegations made in the plaintiff and that the suit was not maintainable, barred by law of limitation. Principles of waiver, estoppels and acquiescence and stated that Abdul Jabbar was owner in possession 4.22 acres of land in the disputed C.S. Khatian no. 

 5. He sold 1.08 acres of land out of plot no. 27 to Shaikh Gopalde Pathan in 1922 at a consideration of TK. 90, But the transfer was not registered. The transferee got possession in the land and constructed homestead and enjoyed the usufructs from other land for more than 12 years and died leaving two sons: Jamil uddin Pathan and Tamjuddin Pathan and one daughter Fatema Begum. Tamizuddin pathan died leaving 4 sons. Hasan Ali, Hosain Ali, Osman Ali, Satter Ali and two daughters. Jamila Khatun and Ramiza Khatun, before the S.A. record was prepared, which was made in the name of Jamir Uddin and others for 3.14, including the 1..08, a parting to suit plot no. 27. In the R.S. Record, in Khatian no. 16 the names of the heirs of Golapdi. Pathan have been recorded for 3.14 acres. Jamiruddin Pattan died leaving Muslimuddin Pathan, Mujibur Pathan, and Aftabuddin Pathan and a daughter Khodeja, Fatema Begum, Hasan Ali Pathan, Hossain Ali Pathan, Osman Ali Pathan, Abdus Satter Pathan, Moslemuddin Pathan and Mojibur Rahman Pathan appointed Mohammad Jamsher Ali their attorney by registered power of attorney dated 26.2.95. The attorney sold in total sold Gyasuddin Sarder & Ors (S.A.B. Mahmudul Hug 1)535 10 decimals, .06 from plot no. 27 and other land from other plots to defendant no. 10 by a deed dated 13.3.95. The defendant no 10. mutated purchased land in Mutation Case and paid rent. The attorney and defendants no. 10 are in possession of their land.
